description: Break ground on a new way to manage construction. Constructable for ChatGPT turns project data into a conversation — ask what's open, what's overdue,  or what happened in the field yesterday, and get a straight answer in seconds. Connect your Constructable account to pull project status, RFIs, submittals, and daily reports straight from chat, no digging required.
